hypotheses.X0_cross_transfer_is_held_out: Every basis is fitted on the discovery panel and every cross-stratum score is evaluated on the replication panel.
hypotheses.X1_declared_stratum_selects_its_best_cha: The matching chart has the highest held-out residual CE-effect fidelity for at least three of four frozen targets.
hypotheses.X2_chart_specificity_is_material: The matching chart beats the best nonmatching chart by at least 0.05 for at least three of four targets.
hypotheses.X3_distance_geometry_is_ordered: At L6, adjacent distance-bin chart pairs have greater mean subspace overlap than nonadjacent pairs.
hypotheses.X4_basis_difference_is_not_required_for_: At least one frozen target fails the 0.05 specificity margin, preserving the possibility that some observational labels merely select interchangeable charts.
